notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card and a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat.
